text:
amelia: Heads up — customer ClearQ flagged a March 27 invoice with ~600k extra embedding tokens compared to yesterday. No traffic uptick on their side. Can ops/finance triage?
tony: I'll pull embedding_events for their account. Any sample request ids from support?
amelia: Support attached request id list and timestamps. First suspicious span around 2027-03-27T14:10Z.
rachel: Quick grep shows a burst of identical requests but with different upstream_ip values that map to the same vendor proxy cluster. Example: request `CQ-77a` appears 4x within 2s with upstream_ip 10.8.9.21 / 10.8.9.23.
tony: Interesting. That suggests the vendor proxy retried requests to multiple origin IPs (multihop replay). Our ingestion keyed dedupe on idempotency_key and vector_hash; those fields were present, but we saw duplicate event_ids inserted.
amelia: Could the proxy be rewriting headers or stripping idempotency?
rachel: Logs show original idempotency header present, but vendor proxy inserted `Via:` and did a transparent reforward where each hop set a new request_id header. Our parser used `request_id` header precedence over idempotency when both present (legacy behavior). So every hop looked like a new request.
tony: Oof. So root cause: parser precedence bug + third-party proxy replays. Distinct from SDK problems.
billing-bot: Alert: customer=clearq dedupe-exception-rate 1.4% (>0.5%).
ops-bot: Created incident INC-2027-448: vendor-proxy-replay causing duplicate ingestion.
amelia: We need an immediate mitigation to avoid billing more customers: change parser to prefer idempotency_header when present regardless of request_id. Can we hotfix this?
rachel: Yes, small change in parsing layer. I'll ship a patch to `ingest/prefer-idempotency` and roll to canary. Also adding a guard: if same idempotency_key seen within 30s, drop subsequent events for billing.
tony: For ClearQ estimate: running aggregation now. Using query: ```sql
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT request_id, idempotency_key, count(*) cnt, sum(tokens) toks
  FROM embedding_events
  WHERE customer_id = 'clearq' AND event_time >= '2027-03-27'::date
  GROUP BY request_id, idempotency_key
  HAVING count(*) > 1
) SELECT sum((cnt-1) * (toks / cnt)) AS dup_tokens FROM dup;
```
-- preliminary result: 602,880 duplicate tokens.
amelia: At $0.00012/token that's ~$72.35. Finance, can we pre-authorize a one-time credit if backfill confirms?
billing-bot: Backfill task BF-2027-882 created (dry-run queued).
ops-bot: Also pinged vendor contact: vendor confirmed an internal proxy bug that can replay to multiple origin IPs during a brief failover window. They pushed a fix and will provide replay logs.
rachel: Dry-run CSV uploaded to ticket. Patch deployed to staging; canary shows ingestion dedupe behaving correctly.
tony: Dry-run final tally matches: 603,012 dup tokens -> $72.36. Uploaded request_id CSV and per-invoice line delta.
amelia: Finance, please review ledger memo "dedupe-backfill: vendor-proxy replay (Mar 27)" and approve. We'll hold invoice adjustment until approval and notify ClearQ after posting.
billing-bot: Ledger adjustment pending manual approval. ID LA-2027-66.
amelia: Also recommend we add an alert for "multiple upstream_ips for same idempotency_key" to catch proxies doing multihop replays.
rachel: Added rule to ingest monitoring: alert if same idempotency_key seen from >1 distinct upstream_ip within 60s.
ops-bot: Vendor provided replay logs and identified ~1.2k requests replayed across two origin IPs.
billing-bot: Backfill BF-2027-882 dry-run completed. Potential credit -$72.36. Awaiting approval.
amelia: Approved. Kevin in finance will post ledger and draft the customer note.
tony: After backfill, confirm that no duplicate billing remains for other customers affected by the same proxy window; running cluster-wide check.
billing-bot: Cluster scan: additional 4 customers with small dup deltas (range 2k-30k tokens). Summed potential impact ~$95. Will create separate ledger adjustments per account.
amelia: OK queue those as well; create a consolidated postmortem linking vendor fix and parser patch. Thanks team.
